name: synergy-engine
description: Unity-style game engine template for TypeScript, built on PlayCanvas. Clone it, build your game.

scripts.typecheck: bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.json && bun check --no-script -p convex/tsconfig.json && bun check --no-script -p cloudflare/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint:project: bun --bun fallow dead-code --quiet --unused-files --unused-exports --unused-types --unused-deps --unlisted-deps --unresolved-imports --duplicate-exports --stale-suppressions && bun --bun fallow architecture --quiet
scripts.preview:local: bun run build && varlock run -- wrangler dev
scripts.preview:deploy: bun run build && varlock run -- wrangler preview
scripts.deploy: bun run build && varlock run -- wrangler deploy
scripts.desktop:dev: varlock run -- bun run scripts/build.ts --outdir desktop/dist && cd desktop && bun ../node_modules/electrobun/bin/electrobun.cjs dev
scripts.desktop:build: varlock run -- bun run scripts/build.ts --outdir desktop/dist && cd desktop && bun ../node_modules/electrobun/bin/electrobun.cjs build --env=stable
